title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1968-08-23

ai_review.summary: Headphone‑friendly soundboard captures a smoking Dark Star/Eleven sequence and an Alligator jam from the legendary 1968 Shrine run.
ai_review.review: This SBD recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, headphone‑ready mix that lets listeners hear every nuance of the 1968 show. Musically the night delivers standout moments – a soaring Dark Star that flows into St. Stephen and The Eleven (despite an edit), plus one of the era’s classic Alligator jams – though a few reviewers note a slightly tentative energy and an incomplete Eleven cut.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly enthusiastic reviews highlight both superb soundboard quality and strong performances, with only minor critiques (cut in The Eleven, slight energy dip) pulling the rating down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced mix described as headphone‑friendly; a few digital clean‑ups noted but no major dropouts or muffiness.

standout_songs: Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong improvisational flow with Dark Star leading into St. Stephen and a fiery Eleven; Alligator jam provides a high‑point mid‑set highlight despite a slight overall tentative vibe.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil starts the Alligator jam a couple of bars early, but his bass drive is still a highlight.
